parsed.explanation: The dossier documents de-facto criminalisation of gender nonconformity and of transition, enforced through indecent-acts and illicit-intercourse provisions carrying up to five years, with no anti-discrimination protection, no legal gender recognition, and no route to change documents. A visitor whose papers and presentation differ has no fallback. Militia and armed-group violence is documented against men accused of homosexuality, including targeting for effeminate dress, with executions in 2015 and torture in 2012. That is organised, state-tolerated targeting, placing the country in the severe band. It is not scored at the lowest tier because the dossier records no statewide near-certain sequence of identification, imprisonment and execution, and the violence evidence is dated and admittedly incomplete. Recent 2026 sources confirm the legal regime persists, and the armed-group channel operates outside the courts with no remedy.
